conversations.answer: ChatGPTYou're right; if the effect depends on a value it also updates, it'll cause an infinite loop.The solution will involve using a local variable within the component to store the last line value and update the signal independently. Here's the modified plan and solution:Solution Plan:Update the prependAndExtractLastLine function to first concatenate the last line with the current data and then remove the control characters.In the TerminalSummary component, use a component-local variable (localLastLine) to hold the last line value.In the effect, update both the local variable and the signal.Let's craft the script:[CODE_BLOCK_0]This script implements the component-local variable to store the last line and avoids any potential infinite loops in the effect.
